description: This file declares classes related to event threading, including an EventThread class implementing IEventThread and an EventThreadFactory for creating event thread instances. It defines the interface and data members for managing a thread that executes queued functions.

classes.name: EventThread
classes.description: Implements an event-driven thread that executes queued functions, providing thread management and synchronization.

classes.name: EventThreadFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of EventThread.

methods.name: createEventThread
methods.description: Creates and returns a new IEventThread instance with the specified thread name.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Flushes the event queue, ensuring all queued functions are executed.

methods.name: addImpl
methods.description: Adds a function to the event thread's queue for execution.

methods.name: threadExecutor
methods.description: Internal method that runs in the thread, executing queued functions.
